Visual details from source observation: popmotion.io 与 /learn/get-started、/pure/animate 均 403 AccessDenied。identity 改 GitHub Popmotion/popmotion：About 写 Simple animation libraries for delightful user interfaces，链回 popmotion.io，标签 v11.0.5。README 标题 The animator's toolbox，命令 npm install popmotion。packages/popmotion/src/index.ts 导出 animate、inertia、spring、keyframes。它是 Motion / Framer Motion 的前身底层库，本条不与已收录 motion 合并。MIT。
